name: Legiones Hereticus
description: Rite of War: Legiones Hereticus, for Emperor’s Children and World Eaters Armies with the Traitor Allegiance. It replaces the Legion’s Legiones Astartes Rite of War: Emperor’s Children Models gain Lords of Profligacy instead of Flawless Execution, and World Eaters Models gain The Nails’ Bite instead of Violence Incarnate.

when.message: Only for Traitor Emperor’s Children or World Eaters
